title: Otori Emu — Panda Rider〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hum hum huuum, hu-hu-hum♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Are we the first to arrive?
I guess it's only natural that no one would be here at such an early hour!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: It is as you have said.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
Miss Emu, practice doesn't start for a while.
Why have you chosen to come so early?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, because I couldn't sleep at all when thinking about what happened the last time♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: The last time?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm talking about the Halloween show, of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Director! We have remarkably many visitors lining up today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh? Excellent!
Let's see what sort of demographic it is this time... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Am... Am I seeing this right?
Are these creatures...crawling out of graves?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, that was me trying to imitate Tsukasa's lines♪ Could you tell? Did I sound like him?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
Yes. You had his vocal quirks down pat.
I can almost visualize the scene that played out that day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, right♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: It was such an enjoyable show, wasn't it, Miss Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Everyone had so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Last year was fun too, but this year was so much more fun!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (Miss Emu is very kind to say that, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (Because of our inadequacies, we were unable to help her accomplish what she really wanted to do last year.)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (But this year...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This year was just full of awesome events, wasn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It started with me finding Tsukasa during his part-time job interview...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Allow me to take my first steps to stardom on one of your stages, and I shall repay you with a plethora of incredible shows the crowds will fall in love with!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did someone say incredible shows?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ Found someone good!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then we got everyone together to throw Tsukasa a fantastic welcoming party♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then we found Rui performing his drone puppet show! And then Tsukasa brought Rui here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then this time, Rui brought a robot along with him! And it was Nene who was controlling the robot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can still remember how exciting every single event felt♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (Miss Emu has finally managed to find the troupe members she had always been looking for.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, we did fail and fight with each other lots at first, and that made me really sad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm glad I didn't give up back then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I didn't give up, so many people are coming to this stage to watch our shows now!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes. It certainly coincides with the thrill and enthusiasm felt around the stage during its prime.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wonder Stage has an audience of smiling faces again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think that's why I'm always having so much fun right now. It's like I'm going on an outing every day♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... That's why...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I really hope that nothing changes, and we can keep the stage here forever.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: As of right now, all plans to knock down Wonder Stage have been suspended indefinitely.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: If Wonder Stage becomes more popular, I am certain that your family will understand where you are coming from.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now that that's decided, we have to do what we can to make sure it happens♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I apologize for reporting this late. The zombie robots that were used in the Halloween show will be taking part in today's park greeting activities.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ohhh, that's great!
I wonder how everyone's gonna react?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I believe a test run is being conducted before practice starts today, so some of them may be already here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gyaaah!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: That sounds like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's Tsukasa! No fair!
He must've bumped into the zombie robots already!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Great! I'm gonna go meet them now too!
Come with me, Mr. Mascot♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Of course.
